mapper.sql: m.id, m.name, m.category, m.source_ext, m.size_x, m.size_y, m.size_z, m.aliases, m.version, m.updated_at, m.file, m.thumbnail, (select count(distinct p.drawing_id) from placement p where p.model_id = m.id) as used_drawings
mapper.select: select from model m order by m.name
select from model m where m.id = #{id}
select id from model where name = #{name}
select exists(select 1 from model where name = #{name} and id <> #{excludeId})
mapper.insert: insert into model (name, category, source_ext, size_x, size_y, size_z, aliases, created_by) values (#{name}, #{category}, #{sourceExt}, #{sizeX}, #{sizeY}, #{sizeZ}, #{aliases,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler}, #{createdBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update: update model set file = #{file}, thumbnail = #{thumbnail} where id = #{id}
